description: The Staff Selection Commission has released the notification for Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Examination 2026 to fill various Group B and Group C posts in different Ministries, Departments and Organisations of the Government of India. This is one of the most awaited recruitment drives of the year, offering opportunities across multiple central government departments.
examPattern: Objective type, computer-based test covering General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, English Comprehension and General Awareness

faqs.question: What is SSC CGL 2026?
faqs.answer: SSC CGL (Combined Graduate Level) 2026 is a national-level exam conducted by the Staff Selection Commission to fill 4,823 Group B and Group C posts such as Assistant Section Officer, Inspector, Sub Inspector, Auditor and Tax Assistant across various central government departments.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for SSC CGL 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university. Those in their final year of graduation can also apply provisionally, though some posts carry additional qualification requirements listed in the official notification.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for SSC CGL 2026?
faqs.answer: The online application window closes on 9 September 2026, with fee payment accepted until 10 September 2026.

faqs.question: How much is the SSC CGL 2026 application fee?
faqs.answer: The fee is ₹100 for General and OBC/EWS candidates. SC, ST, PwBD candidates and all female candidates are exempt from paying any fee.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for SSC CGL 2026?
faqs.answer: Selection happens in three stages: a Tier I computer-based exam, a Tier II computer-based exam, and a final document verification round.
